52034-the-coming-night-a-sermon-preached.title: On Friday, June 12, 1857,
52034-the-coming-night-a-sermon-preached.creator: Unknown
52034-the-coming-night-a-sermon-preached.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Not a sparrow falls to the ground without the Father’s knowledge, and how much more may we be satisfied that “precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.” There are many of his dispensations which seem very dark to short-sighted men, but they all have their sure purpose.

arxiv-1911-03211.title: Finite element simulation of ionic electrodiffusion in cellular geometries
arxiv-1911-03211.creator: A. J. Ellingsrud †,1 , A. Solbrå †,2,3 , G. T. Einevoll 2,3,4 , G. Halnes ∗,2,4 and M. E. Rognes ∗,1
arxiv-1911-03211.description: Abstract Mathematical models for excitable cells are commonly based on cable theory, which considers a homogenized domain and spatially constant ionic concentrations. Although such models provide valuable insight, the effect of altered ion concentrations or detailed cell morphology on the electrical potentials cannot be captured.

arxiv-2208-10783.title: Contact effects on thermoelectric properties of textured graphene nanoribbons
arxiv-2208-10783.creator: David M T Kuo 1 and Yia-Chung Chang 2,3
arxiv-2208-10783.description: Abstract Transport and thermoelectric properties of finite textured graphene nanoribbons (t-GNRs) connected to electrodes with various coupling strengths are theoretically studied in the framework of the tight-binding model and Green’s function approach. Due to quantum constriction induced by the indented edges, such t-GNRs behave like serially-coupled graphene quantum dots (SGQDs).

arxiv-2212-02482.title: Orbital-optimized pair-correlated electron simulations on trapped-ion quantum computers
arxiv-2212-02482.creator: Luning Zhao, Joshua Goings, Kyujin Shin, Woomin Kyoung, Johanna I. Fuks, June-Koo Kevin Rhee, Young Min Rhee, Kenneth Wright, Jason Nguyen, Jungsang Kim, Sonika Johri
arxiv-2212-02482.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Luning Zhao, Joshua Goings, Kyujin Shin, Woomin Kyoung, Johanna I. Fuks, June-Koo Kevin Rhee, Young Min Rhee, Kenneth Wright, Jason Nguyen, Jungsang Kim, Sonika Johri. Variational quantum eigensolvers (VQE) are among the most promising approaches for solving electronic structure problems on near-term quantum computers.

arxiv-2305-06164.title: Conversational Semantic Parsing using Dynamic Context Graphs
arxiv-2305-06164.creator: Parag Jain, Mirella Lapata
arxiv-2305-06164.description: Abstract In this paper we consider the task of conversational semantic parsing over general purpose knowledge graphs (KGs) with millions of entities, and thousands of relation-types. We focus on models which are capable of interactively mapping user utterances into executable logical forms (e.g., Sparql ) in the context of the conversational history.

arxiv-2307-11210.title: Out-of-Order Sliding-Window Aggregation with Efficient Bulk Evictions and Insertions (Extended Version)
arxiv-2307-11210.creator: Kanat Tangwongsan, Martin Hirzel, Scott Schneider
arxiv-2307-11210.description: Abstract . Sliding-window aggregation is a foundational stream processing primitive that efficiently summarizes recent data. The state-of-the-art algorithms for sliding-window aggregation are highly efficient when stream data items are evicted or inserted one at a time, even when some of the insertions occur out-of-order.

arxiv-2408-03491.title: Sidorenko’s conjecture for subdivisions and theta substitutions
arxiv-2408-03491.creator: Seonghyuk Im, Ruonan Li, Hong Liu
arxiv-2408-03491.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Seonghyuk Im, Ruonan Li, Hong Liu. The famous Sidorenko’s conjecture asserts that for every bipartite graph H H , the number of homomorphisms from H H to a graph G G with given edge density is minimized when G G is pseudorandom. We prove that for any graph H H , a graph obtained from replacing edges of H H by generalized theta graphs consisting of even paths satisfies Sidorenko’s conjecture, provided a certain divisibility condition on the number of paths.

arxiv-2502-03311.title: Degenerate higher-order Maxwell-Einstein theories
arxiv-2502-03311.creator: Aimeric Colléaux, Karim Noui
arxiv-2502-03311.description: Abstract We classify higher-order Maxwell-Einstein theories linear in the curvature tensor and quadratic in the derivatives of the electromagnetic field strength whose kinetic matrices are degenerate. This provides a generalisation of quadratic degenerate higher-order scalar-tensor theories for a U(1) gauge field.

arxiv-2504-18915.title: Simulation of a rapid qubit readout dependent on the transmission of a single fluxon
arxiv-2504-18915.creator: W. Wustmann, K.D. Osborn
arxiv-2504-18915.description: Abstract The readout speed of qubits is a major limitation for error correction in quantum information science. We show simulations of a proposed device that gives readout of a fluxonium qubit using a ballistic fluxon with an estimated readout time of less than 1 nanosecond, without the need for an input microwave tone.

arxiv-2510-03237.title: Geometrically expanding the BPS vortex of a non-canonical multi-field theory
arxiv-2510-03237.creator: F. C. E. Lima
arxiv-2510-03237.description: Abstract Abstract: Considering a non-canonical multi-field theory, we propose a mechanism of geometric expansion for Abrikosov-Nielsen–Olesen (ANO) vortices. One builds the general setup adopting a non-canonical O(3)-sigma model, non-minimally coupled through an anomalous magnetic dipole interaction to a gauge and real scalar field.

doe-osti-3022474-collaborative-center-fo.title: Collaborative Center for Plasma Assisted Combustion and Catalysis
doe-osti-3022474-collaborative-center-fo.creator: Adamovich, Igor V., Ju, Yiguang, Koel, Bruce E.
doe-osti-3022474-collaborative-center-fo.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. The focus of the present Center has been on the systematic and fundamental in-depth studies of plasma-assisted combustion and plasma-enhanced catalytic processes at reproducible and well-characterized conditions, using a range of non-intrusive, time-resolved in situ diagnostics.

pmc-11435327.title: Resurgence of Clinical Malaria in Ethiopia and Its Link to Anopheles stephensi Invasion
pmc-11435327.creator: Guofa Zhou, Hiwot S Taffese, Daibin Zhong, Xiaoming Wang, Ming-Chieh Lee, Teshome Degefa, Dejene Getachew, Werissaw Haileselassie, Dawit Hawaria, Delenasaw Yewhalaw, Guiyun Yan, Melissa J Caimano
pmc-11435327.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The invasion of Anopheles stephensi into Africa poses a potential threat to malaria control and elimination on the continent. However, it is not clear if the recent malaria resurgence in Ethiopia has linked to the expansion of An. We obtained the clinical malaria case reports and malaria intervention data from the Ethiopian Ministry of Health (MoH) for the period 2001–2022. We analyzed clinical malaria hotspots and investigated the potential role of An. stephensi in the 2022 malaria outbreaks.

pmc-12110476.title: The Development and Validation of an Attitude Scale for Abortion in Turkey
pmc-12110476.creator: Yusuf Karaşin, Yalçın Karagöz
pmc-12110476.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundAbortion is a complex phenomenon studied not only from a health perspective, but also from a legal and social dimensions. Attitudes towards abortion have been varied significantly across different cultures and historical periods.

pmc-12539019.title: Flash pulmonary edema caused by paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia in a patient with preserved ejection fraction
pmc-12539019.creator: Tingzhi Deng, Ding Li, Lihui Liang, Baiqing Ou
pmc-12539019.description: BackgroundFlash pulmonary edema is a medical emergency in which immediate recognition can be life-saving, especially when patients do not have typical clinical manifestations.Case presentationHerein, we report the case of a 56-year-old man who was admitted to the hospital due to paroxysmal palpitations for one week.

pmc-12570359.title: Measles trend in Gabon: Insight from 18 years of surveillance data
pmc-12570359.creator: Guy Francis Nzengui Nzengui, Hervé M’boyis Kamdem, Ayawa Claudine Kombila Koumavor, Gaël Mourembou, Pélagie Mougola Bissiengou, Daniella Delpo, Rotimi Myrabelle Avome Houechenou, Fabrice Lotola Mougeni, Fortune Barondi Diambou, Annie Badila Missogni, Frédéric Ngoulou, Marcel Mouketou Mabika, Thierry
pmc-12570359.description: SummaryMeasles is a vaccine-preventable infection that can lead to serious illness and death. The delayed implementation of the World Health Organization (WHO)-recommended two doses of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1 and MCV2) and immunity gaps compromise the effort to elimination. Eighteen years (2006–2023) of surveillance data from Gabon measles surveillance program were collected and analyzed.

pmc-12767384.title: Comprehensive Analysis of the Correlation Between Immune‐Inflammatory Biomarkers and Intestinal Necrosis in Patients With Acute Intestinal Ischemia
pmc-12767384.creator: Yu Tian, Feifan Wang, Mingshuo Zhang, Rui Ding, Yimin Wang
pmc-12767384.description: BackgroundThe relationship between immune‐inflammatory biomarkers, including neutrophil‐to‐lymphocyte ratio (NLR), platelet‐to‐lymphocyte ratio (PLR), and systemic immune‐inflammation index (SII) and intestinal necrosis in different types of acute intestinal ischemia remains unclear.MethodsA total of 138 patients with acute intestinal ischemia were divided into a nonnecrosis group (n = 65) and a necrosis group (n = 73).

pmc-13152871.title: Prospective evaluation of the VITOM 3D exoscope in ear surgery compared with surgical microscopes: part II—optical performance, handling, workload and ergonomics
pmc-13152871.creator: Christoph Müller, Hai Yen Tao, Marcus Neudert, Nikoloz Lasurashvili, Thomas Beleites, Thomas Zahnert, Joseph Morgenstern
pmc-13152871.description: Background The aim of this study was to evaluate the feasibility of a 3D exoscope system (VITOM 3D, Karl Storz, Tuttlingen, Germany) in comparison with conventional surgical microscopes (SM, hereafter referred to as ‘microscope’) in ear surgery. This paper represents the second part of a two-part publication series.

pmc-13547521.creator: Solon Alberto Orlando, Alfredo Bruno, Greta Franco-Sotomayor, Miguel Angel García-Bereguiain
pmc-13547521.description: ally including the “Universidad Agraria de Ecuador” and “Escuela Superior Politécnica del Litoral, and later “Universidad de Las Américas,” “Universidad Ecotec” and “Universidad Espiritu Santo.” We were able to put together a group of scientists with different professional expertise from both the public health sector, such as INSPI, and academia.

pmc-13656467.title: The role and therapeutic potential of vitamins in fracture healing
pmc-13656467.creator: Qingyuan Yu, Gongchang Yu, Huiqiang Dong, Chenyu Wang, Mengqi Guan, Bin Shi, Zhenhua Li
pmc-13656467.description: Fracture healing is an energetically demanding, highly orchestrated process in which inflammation, angiogenesis, callus formation and remodelling must be tightly coordinated, yet up to 10% of fractures progress to delayed union or non-union. Emerging evidence positions vitamins as key modulators of osteoimmunology, cellular metabolism and matrix mineralisation across distinct phases of repair.
